role.construction: Defines the fixed uniform native transposition target that any positive construction must meet.
role.impossibility: Defines the unchanged statement whose negation would settle the impossibility program; the multiplication implication is cited background.

items.label: def:local-public-strategy
items.title: Public original-row strategy
items.role: Defines exactly the original-row interface to which the separator obstruction applies.

items.label: thm:local-adaptive-separator
items.title: Adaptive separator bound
items.role: Excludes a fixed fractional broadcast saving when expected separator loss, input deficit and helper entropy are all negligible relative to P.

items.label: cor:local-separator-worst
items.title: Worst-case cost and attained helper range
items.role: Converts the separator inequality to a candidate rejection test from pointwise broadcast/loss bounds and the attained helper range.

items.label: thm:local-separator-sharpness
items.title: Separate sharpness of the two information charges
items.role: Optimal universal finite-model coefficients; does not establish sharpness in the small-deficit/small-helper regime.

items.label: lem:local-treewidth-fragmentation
items.title: Integral fragmentation
items.role: Supplies the integral separator-loss budget used to turn communication savings into a treewidth lower bound.

items.label: cor:local-treewidth
items.title: Savings force large average treewidth
items.role: For high-entropy inputs and small helper entropy, forces linear average treewidth whenever an original-row strategy saves a fixed fraction.

items.label: def:local-recoded-xor
items.title: Recoded fixed-XOR code
items.role: Defines the bounded-packet format tested by the XOR obstruction, allowing nonlinear preprocessing and decoding.

items.label: thm:local-xor-distance
items.title: Distance bound after arbitrary row recoding
items.role: Limits savings via graph-neighborhood volume and supplies both the bounded-degree and path/cycle obstructions.

items.label: cor:local-xor-degree
items.title: Bounded degree
items.role: Rules out fixed fractional savings for fixed maximum degree, including bounded-degree expander support graphs.

items.label: cor:local-xor-cycle
items.title: Paths, cycles, and their embedded subgraphs
items.role: Illustrates the XOR graph-distance method on paths/cycles; the separator theorem has the stronger leading constant on these graphs.

items.label: def:local-triangular-causal
items.title: Triangular and causal row maps
items.role: Specifies the primitive row updates of the two-stage architecture; the own-row bijection condition is the source of block recovery.

items.label: def:local-two-stage
items.title: Two-stage branch and helper selection
items.role: Defines exactly which coupled nonlinear construction attempts the helper-or-deficit obstruction excludes.

items.label: lem:local-block-injective
items.title: Block injectivity
items.role: Derives the recovery property needed for branch counting from the primitive update rules, rather than assuming that property.

items.label: lem:local-branch-count
items.title: A record for one branch
items.role: Bounds each fixed branch correctness family, which is the common input to the helper-range and helper-entropy lower bounds.

items.label: thm:local-helper-count
items.title: Exact helper-or-deficit toll
items.role: Forces a large attained helper range or a large correct-family deficit; full-cube correctness needs at least 2^(b floor(d^2/4)) helper values.

items.label: thm:local-helper-entropy
items.title: Actual helper entropy under arbitrary input laws
items.role: For high-entropy input laws forces actual helper entropy near P/4 as d grows, so a heavily skewed helper distribution does not avoid the obstruction.

items.label: def:motion-star
items.title: The restricted star condition
items.role: Defines the necessary geometric condition used by the affine-time obstruction; preserves the first paper crossing convention.

items.label: thm:motion-affine-time
items.title: Quantitative affine-time obstruction
items.role: Impossibility: quantifies a positive sum of omitted times for any locally affine regions. Construction filter: a candidate must have enough physical motion outside such regions.

items.label: thm:motion-native-limits
items.title: Physical units and native limiting paths
items.role: Transfers the limiting obstruction to actual nonuniform high-entropy correct executions and derives representatives rather than assuming favorable inputs.

items.label: def:motion-affine-cover
items.title: Bounded affine interval cover
items.role: Defines the bounded geometric approximation class used by the closure lemma and native approximation obstruction.

items.label: lem:motion-cover-closure
items.title: Pointwise closure
items.role: Technical bridge for impossibility: pointwise approximants with fixed finite cover size force an almost-everywhere locally affine limit.

items.label: thm:motion-pointwise
items.title: Pointwise approximation obstruction
items.role: Impossibility criterion for native algorithms whose complete head trajectories admit subsequential pointwise bounded-affine-cover approximations.

items.label: thm:motion-palettes
items.title: Bounded-word palette exclusions
items.role: Excludes the three exact bounded-word construction families by deriving native costs and geometry; identifies which class boundaries a surviving word construction must leave.

items.label: def:motion-clock
items.title: Contracting stage clock
items.role: Defines a charged partition of actual execution ticks so a recursive total-time estimate and depth-tail estimate can be proved without free subroutine costs.

items.label: lem:motion-clock-accounting
items.title: Charged depth and exceptional work
items.role: Supplies the linear-time and finite-depth coverage estimates needed by the recursive obstruction; aggregates local exceptional charges for its per-node corollary.

items.label: def:motion-stage-regularity
items.title: Regular sequences of stage occurrences
items.role: States the actual-stage hypothesis under which contracting recursion yields affine physical limits, including sequence-dependent clocks and varying piece bounds.

items.label: thm:motion-exceptional-recursion
items.title: Exceptional-time toll for contracting recursion
items.role: Excludes clocks all of whose stages satisfy affine regularity; gives a constant exceptional-time toll. Does not exclude intended non-affine Mobius stage limits.

items.label: cor:motion-node-exception
items.title: Per-node exceptional budget
items.role: Converts the necessary global exceptional-time allowance into a bound on per-node exceptional-work coefficients.

role.construction: Fully paid data-free prefix with literal coarse-charge CutIneq for arbitrary payloads and full M* limits for linear-time families. Coupling motion to useful encoded data remains open.
role.impossibility: Specialize to an immediately halting empty-output payload to see these geometric conditions are satisfied without transposing. A lower bound needs an additional computation-sensitive property.

role.construction: Discharges the analytic expansion premise needed by continuous_uniform_computation_with_cut, leaving exists_uniform_paid_padding unconditional.
role.impossibility: Supports the wrapper demonstrating the scope limit of the original geometric conditions. Continuous-expander existence is attributed to Bourgain–Yehudayoff, not claimed as novel.

review_scope: Program roles rechecked against revised sections; unchanged statement contracts retained; sharpness, cycle, padding and recursion roles corrected.
